title_en: Ted Lasso Greenlit for Season 5 With Production to Start in April 2027
summary_en: Ted Lasso is coming back to Apple TV for a fifth season, with production set to begin in April 2027.
body_en:
Ted Lasso is coming back to Apple TV for a fifth season, with production set to begin in April 2027.
Apple TV’s beloved comedy series is coming back for another season, and it’s possible that there’s more in store. As pointed out by Variety , Jackson Sudeikis — who will return as both executive producer and star of the show — said he “would like to” continue the project through a sixth season in an October episode of Talk Easy with Sam Fragoso.
“Yeah, I just don’t know,” he told the host when asked about the topic, clarifying that he wasn’t holding anything back “intentionally.” “We haven’t started a writers’ room or anything like that,” he added.
For now, we know that Season 5 is in the bag, but this isn’t a huge surprise. In fact, it was almost a given, seeing how Season 4 was Apple TV’s biggest launch in the platform’s history. Its premiere garnered an astonishing 296.6 million minutes watched , proving the audience’s interest even after its initial storyline wrapped up at the end of Season 3.
Now, Ted’s on a new mission: to coach a women’s football team. The newly formed second-division team, the Lady Greyhounds, take Ted on a parallel journey with new obstacles, primarily navigating the environment of women’s athletics and the unique challenges that come with it.
Ted Lasso has been a hugely successful show, both among fans and critics alike. We at IGN scored its first season a glowing 9 out of 10 , calling it a “relentlessly optimistic and disarmingly charming comedy” that was sorely needed when it was released back in 2020. And while our review of the Season 4 premiere was comparatively softer , it certainly resonated with audiences enough to warrant a continuation of its new storyline.
For those who are unfamiliar with the show, it follows the kind, optimistic Ted Lasso, an American college football coach who gets hired to help a struggling English football league whose owner secretly hopes it fails. It’s a delightful watch, and a premise that has continued to prove sorely sought-after in the six years since its initial release.
Ted Lasso streams exclusively on Apple TV . For more shows streaming on the service, you can check out every series that’s making its way to the platform this November , which includes movies and shows like 12 12 12, Way of the Warrior Kid, and Stick Season 2.
